question.problem: Which of the following is equivalent to $\frac{{x}^{2}-16}{{x}^{2}-5x+6}\cdot \frac{x-3}{x-4}?$
question.worked_solution:
First, we factor all of the expressions and cancel any terms that appear in both a numerator and a denominator. Then, we multiply the numerators and the denominators as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}-16}{{x}^{2}-5x+6}\cdot \frac{x-3}{x-4} & =\frac{(x+4)(x-4)}{(x-2)(x-3)}\cdot \frac{x-3}{x-4} \\  & =\frac{(x+4)\cancel{(x-4)}}{(x-2)\cancel{(x-3)}}\cdot \frac{\cancel{(x-3)}}{\cancel{x-4}} \\  & =\frac{x+4}{x-2}\end{aligned}
$$
